shared.capability_scope: implemented TRIAL-1 only; not Phase1 ceiling
shared.legacy_authority_sha256: Retain the actual immediate-plan hash in coverage/manifest for backwards-compatible architecture identity only; it is not sole authority.

registry.features: Exact existing nine features; no archived M0-008..019 live directories/dependencies.
registry.interfaces: Exact existing eight uniquely owned IF@r2 agreements; document revision r3 does not change runtime contract revision.

acceptance.scopeRefs: Nonempty exact immediate-plan.md:Lx-Ly locators, including appropriate boundary/context segments for new SYSTEM gaps.
acceptance.productRefs: Array of exact PRD - AI4Research.txt:Lx-Ly locators; may be empty for pure trial assertions.
acceptance.phase1Units: Array of current product-unit IDs; empty permitted for partial supporting trial assertions. All complete product-unit owners reciprocate exactly.
acceptance.new_system_gaps: AC-018..027; B18..27; V35..54; source ownership does not establish current PASS.

coverage.active_scope_units: Retain all eight exact IP heading ranges/hashes and reciprocal AC scopeRefs.

prd_phase1_units.owners: Exactly one complete {task,ac} owner per unit; exact reciprocal registry phase1Units. Supporting trial contributors are not complete product owners.
prd_phase1_units.selection: Nonempty English description of selected Phase 1 duties and excluded/conditional portions; mixed sections must preserve separate Phase 2/3/Future boundaries.
prd_phase1_units.rationale: Nonempty English source-based reason for applicability/selection.
prd_phase1_units.hash_rule: SHA256(UTF8(join source.splitlines()[start-1:end] with LF plus terminal LF)).
prd_phase1_units.source_bullets_optional: [{line:int,text:exact source line,disposition:enum}]. If included, lines must stay within this unit, unique and byte/text-exact.
prd_phase1_units.inventory: Exact 148 reviewed active leaf/global/stage units, including separately owned PRD-5.PREFACE L2261-L2265.

prd_context.inventory: All 184 numbered headings preserve exact id/title/line.
prd_context.phase1Units: Exact applicable product-unit IDs. Nonempty for active/global/mixed dispositions; empty for genuinely separate/future/excluded headings unless a selected mixed boundary is explicitly represented.

evidence.old_trial_rows: Preserve exact r2 evidence/progress only for unchanged bounded trial criteria. New productRefs do not expand prior PASS into full Phase1.
evidence.new_phase1_gaps: NOT_RUN initially. A future PASS requires checked implementation/check work and new linked observed native runtime proof for that exact Phase1 AC/check/candidate; trial/model-fixture/doc-only evidence is insufficient.
evidence.documentary_ac001: Renew documentary r3 evidence after changing allocation; historical r2 scope evidence stays immutable.

phase1_json_prerequisite.checks: Exact required V identifiers mapped to PASS
phase1_json_prerequisite.observations: Nonempty list of actual native observations. Documentary format is necessary, never independently sufficient for runtime acceptance.

scope_guard: Reject active unit labels/owners that promote separate Phase2 RSI execution or Phase3 dynamic execution; conditional Phase1 fixture scaffolding/security or experimental configuration is not such promotion.
